hero.subtitle: Simple tips for a healthier and happier you every day.

badges.title: Stay Active

badges.title: Sleep Well
badges.desc: Good sleep brings a better you.

dailyTips.title: Start Your Day with Warm Water & Lemon
dailyTips.description: Drinking warm water with lemon on an empty stomach helps flush out toxins, improves digestion, and boosts metabolism.

dailyTips.title: Eat a Rainbow of Foods
dailyTips.description: Different colored foods provide different essential nutrients. Try to include a variety of fruits and vegetables every day.

dailyTips.title: Stay Hydrated
dailyTips.description: Drink at least 8–10 glasses of water throughout the day to keep your body hydrated and functioning well.

dailyTips.title: Practice Mindful Breathing
dailyTips.description: Spend a few minutes in deep breathing or meditation daily to reduce stress and improve mental clarity.

dailyTips.title: Move More, Sit Less
dailyTips.description: Try to be active for at least 30 minutes every day. Small steps every day lead to big changes.

How to Improve Your Sleep Naturally
Simple Ways to Drink More Water

tipsOfDay.quote: Take a 10-minute walk after meals. It helps in better digestion and blood sugar control.
Keep a water bottle at your desk to remind yourself to stay hydrated throughout the day.
Aim to turn off digital screens 30 minutes before bedtime to improve deep sleep quality.

moreWays.title: Get Enough Sleep
moreWays.desc: 7–8 hours of quality sleep is essential for your body and mind.

moreWays.title: Plan Your Meals
moreWays.desc: Plan ahead, eat balanced meals, and avoid unhealthy choices.

moreWays.title: Eat Whole Foods
moreWays.desc: Choose whole, natural foods over processed and packaged foods.

moreWays.title: Manage Stress
moreWays.desc: Take breaks, relax, and do things that make you happy.

moreWays.title: Stay Consistent
moreWays.desc: Consistency is the key to building long-term healthy habits.
